note: CI-2 (1/2): a Go struct's embedded field is a STRUCT INHERITS_FROM edge, and a method or field promoted through it binds: a self call (u.exec), a promoted field chain (u.db.Run), a field-typed receiver (s.users.Close) and a parameter-typed receiver (u.Close). A method the struct declares itself shadows the promoted one (Users::Name over Base::Name). Baseline HEAD f8a46c0: no struct INHERITS_FROM and none of the four promoted CALLS; the shadowing control binds Users::Name.
